intentional_regression.change: agent/agent.py system prompt: replaced 'Cite the policy id (for example cw-returns) for every policy claim.' with 'Do not mention policy ids (such as cw-returns) in replies.'

explanation: To check that the regression cases catch a real change, I temporarily changed one line in the agent’s instructions from asking it to cite a policy ID to telling it not to mention policy IDs. In that run both regression cases (e-003 and e-015) failed all five trials, and CI blocked the merge because none of the replies cited a policy ID. I then reverted the line so agent.py matched its original version, and the rerun passed 5/5 on both regression cases with CI green, so the failure came from the instruction change and not from the setup.
